runs.t: Which description best captures the main purpose of

options.text: A circuit breaker prevents repeated calls to an unhealthy dependency from exhausting resources and cascading failures.
ACID describes atomicity, consistency, isolation and durability of database transactions.
PACELC extends CAP: if partitioned, choose between availability and consistency; else, even in normal operation, choose between latency and consistency.
Distributed business workflows often span independent services that cannot share one ACID transaction.

runs.t: Which implementation approach most directly applies

options.text: Under partition, a consistency-oriented system may reject or delay operations to avoid contradictory answers; an availability-oriented system may accept operations that reconcile later.
Use asynchronous replication, derived views and reconciliation rules to keep serving useful operations.
Study quorums, leader election, replicated logs, safety versus liveness, and fault models.
Define failure thresholds, observation windows, reset timeouts and probe traffic.

runs.t: Which practical project example best illustrates

options.text: If an external currency-rate API becomes unavailable, a checkout may temporarily use the last verified rate when policy allows, or fail fast without tying up every request worker.
A distributed configuration store can use Raft so nodes agree on the order of config updates. Application servers read committed state instead of inventing their own leader election protocol.
A travel booking saga reserves a room, charges a card and books transport. If transport fails, the coordinator cancels the room and requests a payment refund with traceable outcomes.
A reservation inventory should avoid confirming the same last room twice, so some write requests may wait during an outage. A social feed might keep serving slightly stale content.

options.text: Circuit Breaker припиняє повторні звернення до несправної залежності, щоб не виснажити ресурси й не запустити каскад відмов.
ACID описує атомарність, узгодженість, ізоляцію та довговічність транзакцій БД.
PACELC розширює CAP: за partition постає вибір між доступністю й узгодженістю; в нормальному режимі — між затримкою й узгодженістю.

Під час partition система, орієнтована на узгодженість, відхиляє або затримує операції; орієнтована на доступність може приймати зміни з подальшим узгодженням.
